scope: Curated primary-source selection, not exhaustive latest or universal best ranking

datasets.name: SPL Open Data free throws
datasets.status: 12 selected frames bundled and executed; full release not downloaded
datasets.size: Selected source trial 2,385,805 bytes; release 583 trials across two sessions
datasets.units: xyz feet; hoop outcome inches; angle degrees; recent session 60 fps
datasets.baseline: Unit/clock checks, landmark angles, fixed-gravity versus free quadratic
datasets.split: Athlete/session/trial; stable athlete IDs across sessions
datasets.metrics: Held-out trajectory errors with reference type; missingness; timing uncertainty
datasets.limits: One selected trial cannot test prediction; no verified release label; noisy volume boundaries.

datasets.name: SkillCorner Open Data / body pose
datasets.kind: Broadcast-derived XY, physical profiles and model-estimated 3D pose
datasets.status: 12 profile rows bundled; full tracking/pose unexecuted
datasets.license: MIT repository license; inspect dataset-specific hosting terms
datasets.size: 10 sample matches; XY example 97 MB; full pose approximately 3.3 GB per match
datasets.units: XY metres at 10 fps; pose 29 joints at 25 fps; predicted error cm
datasets.baseline: Constant-velocity tracks and detected-only coverage before learned models
datasets.split: Match first, then independent teams/venues as required; player groups for profiles
datasets.metrics: Localization/identity errors, observed-versus-extrapolated coverage; temporal alignment
datasets.limits: Pose relative z may differ from global pitch z; XY interpolated to 25 fps is not 25 Hz independent XY measurement; full payloads need Git LFS/HF.

datasets.name: BasketHAR
datasets.status: Primary paper inspected; hosted data not retrieved; not bundled
datasets.license: Paper states Apache 2.0; verify actual hosted artifact license before acquisition
datasets.size: Not verified; inspect hosting file inventory before download
datasets.units: Per-sensor units, clock offsets, rate and calibration must be read from release; not guessed
datasets.baseline: Window statistics with subject-grouped evaluation; compare each modality
datasets.split: Subject/session; keep synchronized windows and overlaps together
datasets.metrics: Macro F1, balanced accuracy, latency and sensor failure sensitivity
datasets.limits: Paper claims are not reproduced; synchronization and labels must be verified before fusion.

datasets.name: MUVS
datasets.kind: Real handheld multiview videos and device sensors
datasets.status: Repository record/README inspected; video and sensor payloads not downloaded
datasets.license: License field not resolved in rendered record; obtain explicit release/media terms before redistribution
datasets.size: 17 events; 5,039 three-second fragments; 258 period videos; 9.8 MB record files exclude hosted video payload
datasets.units: Video/sensor clocks and device frames require manifest; camera-selection labels are not 3D ground truth
datasets.baseline: Timestamp audit and simple camera-selection policy before learned reconstruction
datasets.split: Whole event across all views; independent venues/devices when possible
datasets.metrics: Selection agreement, synchronization residuals; separate independently measured geometry checks
datasets.limits: Do not equate synchronized views or sensor records with metrically calibrated cameras.

datasets.name: UVY / UVY-Track
datasets.sport: Seven sports including basketball, soccer, tennis and cricket
datasets.kind: User-generated video with multi-object tracking labels
datasets.license: Provider says source videos CC BY; record license field not fully rendered; verify per-video and annotation terms
datasets.size: 20 videos; 31,961 annotated frames; 128,258 boxes; 378 tracks; 3.3 GB ZIP
datasets.units: Pixel boxes and track IDs, not calibrated 3D metres
datasets.baseline: Detector plus tracker, compare with supplied labels
datasets.split: Video/event/uploader context; never adjacent-frame random split
datasets.metrics: HOTA/IDF1 plus detection recall and occlusion breakdown
datasets.limits: Semi-automatic annotations with manual review remain reference labels, not perfect physical truth; UVY and MUVS are different.

datasets.name: TrackID3x3
datasets.kind: Indoor/outdoor fixed-camera and drone video with tracks and partial pose labels
datasets.status: Official repository inspected; linked video not downloaded
datasets.license: Dataset CC BY 4.0; original code Apache 2.0; third-party jersey pipeline CC BY-NC 3.0
datasets.size: Inspect linked file inventory; no size invented here
datasets.units: Six on-court players; boxes all frames; ten pose keypoints some frames; metric mapping needs court calibration
datasets.baseline: Tracking/identification baseline with manual court localization separated from learned steps
datasets.metrics: TI-HOTA/identity and court localization, conditioned on visibility
datasets.limits: Partial pose coverage is not complete 3D mocap; code/weights/data licenses differ.

datasets.name: SoccerTrack v2
datasets.kind: Full-pitch panoramic 4K match video with reconstruction and ball-action labels
datasets.status: Primary paper inspected; payload not downloaded
datasets.license: Dataset license not verified from abstract; inspect linked host before acquisition
datasets.size: 10 full-length university matches; storage budget not verified
datasets.units: Annotated 2D pitch positions, jersey IDs, roles, teams; 12 ball-action classes
datasets.baseline: Annotated positions to team-shape descriptors; simple temporal action baseline
datasets.split: Match/venue, retaining all views and contiguous windows in one group
datasets.metrics: Tracking/reconstruction accuracy and event timing/matching under official protocol
datasets.limits: 2D pitch labels do not provide airborne metric ball/player height.

datasets.name: SoccerNet Game State Reconstruction
datasets.date: Task page checked 2026-09-21; page retains historical 2024 challenge placeholder
datasets.status: Official task description inspected; media not downloaded
datasets.license: Review current task data/media access agreement; not assumed permissive
datasets.size: Page lists 57 train, 59 validation, 50 test clips of 30 seconds at 1080p
datasets.units: On-field coordinates, roles, teams and jersey IDs; see official coordinate specification
datasets.baseline: Official development kit and a simple calibrated tracking baseline
datasets.split: Official partitions; prohibit tuning on test results
datasets.limits: Page includes an unresolved challenge count; not presented as verified 2026 challenge statistics.

datasets.name: OpenBiomechanics
datasets.date: Current repository documents 2026-07-04 history rewrite and release-based distribution
datasets.kind: C3D motion capture, processed signals, POI and force-plate assessments
datasets.status: Current official README/license wording inspected; data not bundled
datasets.license: Data/documentation CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 with additional professional-sports/financial-firm exclusion; code MIT
datasets.size: 411 pitching trials/100 athletes; 677 swing trials/98 athletes; 1,934 assessments/1,162 athletes; approximately 1.1 GB large release compressed
datasets.units: Per-column dictionaries; marker signals 360 Hz and force plates 1,080 Hz; POI units vary
datasets.baseline: Validated ID joins and conventional biomechanics before topological descriptors
datasets.split: Athlete/session; session_pitch or session_swing joins; no unsupported cross-module person linkage
datasets.metrics: Signal reconstruction or target-specific held-out errors; not injury prediction without injury labels
datasets.limits: Current download path differs from old clones. Additional license restriction is material; no commercial/pro-team permission is granted here.

datasets.name: BASKET-Multiview
datasets.date: Current official dataset page inspected 2026-09-21; release date not asserted
datasets.status: Official description inspected; render payload not downloaded
datasets.license: Inspect dataset license and any SMPL/asset restrictions separately
datasets.size: 1080p/4K renders at 30 fps; choose bounded scene/camera subset
datasets.units: Simulator camera parameters, depth, segmentation, normals and meshes; verify coordinate conventions
datasets.metrics: Errors against simulator truth plus separate real-data transfer evaluation
datasets.limits: Excellent known-answer controls do not validate real-world camera calibration or athlete dynamics.
